summary: The New York Times reports the U.S. warned Iran that Israel planned to assassinate Foreign Minister Araghchi and Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf, prompting extraordinary Iranian protective measures including an emergency landing for Ghalibaf's plane after detection of Israeli jets in Iranian airspace near Iraq. Iran simultaneously began multi-day funeral ceremonies for Supreme Leader Khamenei with high-level delegations from China, Belarus, Iraq, Turkey, Georgia, Afghanistan, and Kurdish regions. In Lebanon, a reserve soldier was seriously wounded in a southern clash while daily monitoring recorded 124 alerts and multiple Israeli strikes.
key_points: NYT reveals U.S. warned Iran of Israeli assassination plots against FM Araghchi and Speaker Ghalibaf; Iranian security forced Ghalibaf's plane emergency landing in Mashhad after detecting two Israeli fighter jets crossing Iranian airspace near Iraq border. (Source: @shin_persian/7341)

Iran begins funeral ceremonies for Supreme Leader Khamenei with foreign dignitaries including Chinese VP He Wei, Belarusian speaker Igor Sergeyenko, Iraqi Parliament Speaker Haibat al-Halbousi, and delegations from Turkey, Georgia, Afghanistan, and Kurdish regions. (Sources: @presstv/196638, @presstv/196643, @SharghDaily/169493, @SharghDaily/169482, @naya_foriraq/80683)

IDF Chief of Staff Zamir marks 1,000th day of multi-front war, designates Iran as military's "central focus," warns all theaters interconnected and active, requires readiness for rapid escalation. (Source: @manniefabian/58726)

Reserve soldier seriously wounded in southern Lebanon clash; IDF confirms evacuation. Lebanese daily stats show 124 alerts, 114 drone sightings, strikes on Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Barishit, artillery on Beit Yahoun and Arnoun. (Sources: @N12chat/215717, @redlinkleb/29560)

Shin Bet arrests Tajik citizen with Russian passport for Iranian intelligence espionage; suspect documented missile impacts, photographed Azrieli towers, Haifa port, attempted sensitive northern facility imaging, recruited others. (Source: @New_security8200/202188)

Speaker Ghalibaf denies IAEA access to damaged nuclear sites, limits inspector access to Bushehr plant and Tehran reactor per SNSC decision; rejects any privileges beyond legal framework. (Source: @VahidOnline/76771)

Three Israeli Arabs charged with supplying weapon to terrorist in fatal Kochav Yair/Tzur Natan attack killing Reserve Sgt. Maj. Haim Kalamiti; one suspect allegedly knew attack plan but didn't report. (Source: @pkpoi/143105)
Bloomberg reports several European countries now agree ships passing through Strait of Hormuz will pay Iran and Oman. (Source: @asafroz/50936)

points: Iran began multi-day funeral ceremonies for Supreme Leader Khamenei at Tehran's Grand Mosalla with high-level foreign delegations including Chinese Vice Chairman He Wei, Belarusian House Speaker Igor Sergeyenko, Iraqi Parliament Speaker Haibat al-Halbousi, Turkish party delegations, Georgian officials, Afghan resistance commander Ahmad Massoud, and Kurdistan Region President Nechirvan Barzani meeting FM Araghchi. (Sources: @presstv/196638, @presstv/196643, @SharghDaily/169493, @SharghDaily/169482, @SharghDaily/169492, @naya_foriraq/80683)

The New York Times reports the U.S. relayed warnings through regional states that Israel might assassinate Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf during negotiations; Iran assigned military escorts and made last-minute travel changes; Ghalibaf's plane made an emergency landing in Mashhad after Iranian security flagged intelligence that two Israeli fighter jets had crossed into Iranian airspace near the Iraq border. (Source: @shin_persian/7341)

Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf denied IAEA access to damaged nuclear sites, stating reports of such access are "false"; per the law passed by Parliament and the SNSC decision, access is limited to Bushehr nuclear power plant and Tehran reactor only; no privileges will be granted beyond the legal framework. (Source: @VahidOnline/76771)

IRGC commander Ahmad Vahidi continued tours in Tehran ahead of Friday's funeral ceremonies; Ghalibaf met representatives of Lebanon's Amal movement, Hezbollah's ally, who arrived for the funeral events. (Sources: @asafroz/50938, @asafroz/50940)
Bloomberg reports several European countries now agree that ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz will pay Iran and Oman. (Source: @asafroz/50936)

A Tehran resident described extensive street closures with Jersey barriers, two lanes designated for procession buses, GPS disruption inside the city, and massive food distributions including tons of rice and meat for neighborhood mourning ceremonies. (Source: @mamlekate/103785)

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir marked the 1,000th day of the multi-front war, stating Iran remains the military's "central focus"; all theaters remain active at varying levels of intensity, are interconnected, and the IDF must remain vigilant for rapid escalation and immediate return to fighting on all fronts. (Source: @manniefabian/58726)

A reserve soldier was seriously wounded in a clash in southern Lebanon yesterday; the soldier was evacuated to hospital and family notified, confirmed by IDF Spokesperson and multiple Hebrew outlets. (Sources: @N12chat/215717, @yediotnews25/132228, @idf_telegram/24506)
IDF forces responded to a reported ramming attempt near Beit Ummar in the Etzion Brigade; no casualties; forces pursued suspects and conducted searches in the area. (Source: @New_security8200/202201)

Shin Bet and YAMAR Erezim arrested a Tajik citizen holding a Russian passport in June 2026 for security offenses involving contact with Iranian intelligence; from January 2026 he documented Iranian missile impact sites during "Roar of the Lion," photographed Azrieli towers, Haifa port, attempted to photograph a sensitive northern facility, and actively recruited others for Iranian tasks. (Source: @New_security8200/202188)

Three Israeli Arabs charged with selling weapons to the terrorist who carried out the fatal shooting near Kochav Yair and Tzur Natan killing Reserve Sgt. Maj. Haim Kalamiti and wounding five; one suspect allegedly knew of the attack plan but did not report it. (Source: @pkpoi/143105)

IDF Chief of Staff honored battery commander Capt. Nathan John Farno and additional commanders from his battery, as well as the entire U.S. air defense array deployed in Israel throughout the war. (Source: @inon_yttach/9260)

sections.threat_assessment: The reported U.S. warning of Israeli assassination plans against Iran's top diplomats, coupled with the alleged Israeli airspace incursion near Iraq, indicates a significant escalation in covert confrontation. Iran's public denial of IAEA access to damaged nuclear sites while hosting a massive diplomatic funeral suggests a dual strategy of projecting strength and consolidating regional alliances. The ongoing Lebanon clashes, daily drone saturation, and the arrest of an Iranian-directed operative inside Israel demonstrate persistent multi-front pressure. Israel's 1,000-day war marker and Zamir's emphasis on interconnected theaters imply sustained high operational tempo.
sections.regional_response: The unprecedented gathering of Chinese, Belarusian, Iraqi, Turkish, Georgian, Afghan, and Kurdish leaders at Khamenei's funeral signals broad regional and extra-regional recognition of Iran's pivotal role. European agreement on Hormuz transit payments to Iran and Oman reflects shifting maritime security calculations. Lebanese Amal's presence in Tehran and Iraqi/Kurdish participation underscore the depth of Iran's proxy and partner network. The region appears to be hedging between containment and accommodation of Iranian influence.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Tajik operative's recruitment via a seemingly legitimate job offer reveals Iranian intelligence's evolving tradecraft targeting foreign nationals in Israel. The specific targeting of missile impact documentation, strategic infrastructure photography, and recruitment networks indicates a structured collection campaign. Ghalibaf's emergency landing triggered by real-time airspace penetration alerts suggests Iran's integrated air defense and intelligence sharing functions effectively. The 11,000 homes figure for south Lebanon, if accurate, implies massive civilian displacement affecting Hezbollah's operational environment.
